edb134d8-c51a-4de2-bf52-dab3af05845d/Opt.en: Everyone, I want to re-enter Mt. Chai immediately to rescue Huanxin...
edb134d8-c51a-4de2-bf52-dab3af05845d/Opt.cn: 诸位，我欲立即重入柴山，救出焕心……
edb134d8-c51a-4de2-bf52-dab3af05845d/Opt.ru: Все, я хочу немедленно вернуться на гору Чай, чтобы спасти Хуаньсинь...

e2cc7d8b-291a-4dc0-ab7a-0ce991814758/Eve.en: Shishufu saw that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s expression was sorrowful,<NL>he gently pressed his palms together, stepped forward slowly, and said in a soft tone:<NL><NL>"Amitabha Terrace... How could we not know the pain in your heart, benefactor...<NL>Miss Huanxin sacrificed herself to face danger, her righteousness admirable. Everyone here is deeply grateful and worries about her constantly,<NL>so regarding the matter of returning to Mt. Chai, this old monk has already discussed it in detail with everyone for many days..."
e2cc7d8b-291a-4dc0-ab7a-0ce991814758/Eve.cn: 室述辅见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />神色怆然，<NL>双掌轻轻合十，缓步上前，柔声安慰道：<NL><NL>“阿弥陀佛……施主心中之苦，老衲等又岂能不知……<NL>焕心姑娘舍身赴难，义烈可佩，此间众人感念至深，亦无时不为她悬心，<NL>故而重返柴山一事，老衲已与诸位细细商议多日……”

e2cc7d8b-291a-4dc0-ab7a-0ce991814758/Opt.en: I see... Does the Grandmaster already have a plan?
e2cc7d8b-291a-4dc0-ab7a-0ce991814758/Opt.cn: 原来如此……莫非大师已有对策？
e2cc7d8b-291a-4dc0-ab7a-0ce991814758/Opt.ru: Я понимаю... Есть ли у гроссмейстера уже какой-то план?

5d3d3a46-7968-40cb-bb14-5f2d85abf01e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, hearing this, calmed down a bit and then cupped his hands to ask,<NL>but just as Shishufu was about to speak again, Immortal Xu interrupted, saying urgently:<NL>"Hmph! The Mt. Chai Ancestor may be immensely powerful, but the little Taiwu child's skills are not to be feared!<NL>If all of us here work together in unison, it would be hard to be defeated...<NL><NL>This defeat is all because those twelve black lights are too troublesome,<NL>we have stumbled over them time and again!"
5d3d3a46-7968-40cb-bb14-5f2d85abf01e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />闻言心神稍定，复又拱手相询，<NL>却见室述辅正欲再言，徐仙公已抢过话头，急急道：<NL>“哼！那柴山元祖固然神通广大，可太吾小娃一身本事，本也不惧他！<NL>若是此间众人齐心合力，此呼彼应，纵想落败亦是难事……<NL><NL>此番失利，全因那十二道黑光太过棘手，<NL>我等几次三番，皆是折在这上头！”

5d3d3a46-7968-40cb-bb14-5f2d85abf01e/Opt.en: Those twelve black lights are indeed strange and peculiar, dispersing only to gather again, unending and indestructible...
5d3d3a46-7968-40cb-bb14-5f2d85abf01e/Opt.cn: 那十二道黑光确实古怪异常，散而复聚，生生不灭……
5d3d3a46-7968-40cb-bb14-5f2d85abf01e/Opt.ru: Эти двенадцать черных огней действительно странные и своеобразные, рассеивающиеся только для того, чтобы собраться снова, бесконечные и неразрушимые...

e527ebc0-241b-45d7-863e-4f2e1e81def5/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, hearing this, fell into thought:<NL>Daoist Tainted once said that the primitive spirit of the Mt. Chai Ancestor is not one entity,<NL>but is hidden separately within those twelve black lights, residing in twelve hidden places in the world,<NL>hence, it is absolutely impossible to truly defeat him within Mt. Chai. Could it be...<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> pondered for a moment, a glint in his eyes...
e527ebc0-241b-45d7-863e-4f2e1e81def5/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />听闻此言，若有所思：<NL>染尘子道长曾言，柴山元祖的元神并非一体，<NL>而是分藏于那十二道黑光之中，寄于世间十二处隐秘之地，<NL>故而无论如何，绝不可能在柴山将其真正击败，莫非……<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />沉吟片刻，眸光微动……

e527ebc0-241b-45d7-863e-4f2e1e81def5/Opt.en: We must first find the hiding places of these twelve black lights and break them one by one to sever the root...
e527ebc0-241b-45d7-863e-4f2e1e81def5/Opt.cn: 要先找到这十二道黑光的藏身之处，逐一击破，方能绝其本根……
e527ebc0-241b-45d7-863e-4f2e1e81def5/Opt.ru: Сначала мы должны найти тайники этих двенадцати черных огней и разбить их один за другим, чтобы отсечь корень...

46816bc7-849e-4d98-bae5-f0df6eefab69/Eve.en: Immortal Xu nodded, stroked his "beard" and said:<NL><NL>"The little Taiwu child is indeed sharp, hitting the nail on the head!<NL>I was going to keep it a secret and explain in detail for you...<NL>Since you are so clever, I suppose there's no need!"
46816bc7-849e-4d98-bae5-f0df6eefab69/Eve.cn: 徐仙公点点头，捋了捋“胡子”道：<NL><NL>“太吾小娃果然厉害，一语中的，正是如此！<NL>老夫本还想卖个关子，细细说与你听……<NL>你这般聪慧，看来是不必啦！”
46816bc7-849e-4d98-bae5-f0df6eefab69/Eve.ru: Бессмертный Сюй кивнул, погладил свою "бороду" и сказал:<NL><NL>"Маленький ребенок Тайу действительно сообразителен, он попал в самую точку!<NL>Я собирался сохранить это в секрете и подробно объяснить вам...<NL>Поскольку ты такой умный, я полагаю, в этом нет необходимости!"

46816bc7-849e-4d98-bae5-f0df6eefab69/Opt.en: But what exactly are these black lights, and where should we go to destroy them?
46816bc7-849e-4d98-bae5-f0df6eefab69/Opt.cn: 却不知黑光究竟是何邪物，又当去何处破除？
46816bc7-849e-4d98-bae5-f0df6eefab69/Opt.ru: Но что именно представляют собой эти черные огни и куда мы должны пойти, чтобы уничтожить их?

bb46b171-8c96-430c-bf77-6871aed16abc/Eve.en: If we are to turn the tide, the urgent task is to subdue these twelve evil beings.<NL>With this thought, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> unconsciously reached out and gripped the "Fuyu Hilt" tightly,<NL><NL>True Qi surged, instantly stirring the twelve remnants of Dark Aura within the "Fuyu Hilt",<NL>which unexpectedly connected with <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s mind.<NL>In an instant, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s eyes conjured twelve figures, each of a different form, sinister and unfathomable...
bb46b171-8c96-430c-bf77-6871aed16abc/Eve.cn: 若欲扭转乾坤，当务之急便是降伏这十二个邪物，<NL>此念一出，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />不觉伸手紧攥「伏虞剑柄」，<NL><NL>真气流转，霎时令「伏虞剑柄」中残存的十二道黑气大动，<NL>竟与<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心神相通，<NL>仅是一瞬，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />眼前兀自浮现出十二个形貌各异，邪诡莫测之人……

bb46b171-8c96-430c-bf77-6871aed16abc/Opt.en: So these are the twelve evil beings transformed into... people?
bb46b171-8c96-430c-bf77-6871aed16abc/Opt.cn: 此即十二邪物所化之……人？
bb46b171-8c96-430c-bf77-6871aed16abc/Opt.ru: Значит, это и есть двенадцать злых существ, превращенных в... людей?

f6de2c70-b281-4585-9a10-3e5843b21e34/Eve.en: At the same time, twelve strands of Dark Aura spread from the hilt,<NL>finely interlinking like silk threads, each slithering like a snake,<NL>as if pointing directly to the locations of these twelve sinister figures...
f6de2c70-b281-4585-9a10-3e5843b21e34/Eve.cn: 与此同时，十二道黑气自剑柄之上蔓延开来，<NL>细细勾连如丝，根根游弋如蛇，<NL>仿佛直指这十二个邪诡之人所在之处……
f6de2c70-b281-4585-9a10-3e5843b21e34/Eve.ru: В то же время двенадцать нитей Темной ауры распространились от рукояти,<NL>тонко переплетающиеся, как шелковые нити, каждая из которых скользит, как змея,<NL>как будто указывая прямо на местонахождение этих двенадцати зловещих фигур...

f6de2c70-b281-4585-9a10-3e5843b21e34/Opt.en: The twelve evil beings can no longer hide! Huanxin... Is it you helping me!
f6de2c70-b281-4585-9a10-3e5843b21e34/Opt.cn: 十二邪物已然无所遁形！焕心……莫非是你助我！
f6de2c70-b281-4585-9a10-3e5843b21e34/Opt.ru: Двенадцать злых существ больше не могут прятаться! Хуаньсинь... Это ты мне помогаешь!

f2cb9f01-b8be-45e1-aae0-27704dd7d936/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gently caressed the "Fuyu Hilt", a warmth rising in his heart.<NL>Huanxin was entangled in a life-and-death struggle with the twelve black lights, and he was already connected with Huanxin heart and mind.<NL>No matter how the twelve evil beings concealed themselves, in his eyes, it was like a mirror reflecting objects, impossible to hide!
f2cb9f01-b8be-45e1-aae0-27704dd7d936/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />轻抚「伏虞剑柄」，心头一热，<NL>焕心与十二道黑光生死纠缠，而自己与焕心早已心意相连，<NL>十二邪物纵然千般隐匿，在自己眼中，也不过是明镜照物，无所遁形！

f2cb9f01-b8be-45e1-aae0-27704dd7d936/Opt.ru: (Я ничего не желаю больше, чем этого!)

3b8c7457-d2ba-4533-9541-7d0122b7524d/Eve.en: "Oh! The little Taiwu child has seen through the locations of the twelve evil beings?"<NL><NL>Immortal Xu exclaimed in surprise, then stroked his "beard" and nodded in realization:<NL>"I see... The girl Huanxin is entangled with those twelve black lights,<NL>and you are connected with her heart and mind. No matter how deeply those evil things hide, they are clear to your eyes... wait..."
3b8c7457-d2ba-4533-9541-7d0122b7524d/Eve.cn: “噫！太吾小娃竟已看破十二邪物所在？”<NL><NL>徐仙公惊讶一叹，旋即捋了捋“胡子”，恍然点头道：<NL>“原来如此……焕心女娃与那十二道黑光纠缠不休，<NL>你与她心意相连，那些邪物藏得再深，在你眼里自是瞧得分明……等等……”

64f91d5f-76bf-4f0f-b5c2-5d129718bc0b/Eve.en: "Could it be...<NL>The girl Huanxin had already seen through the tricks of these twelve evil beings, and that's why..."<NL><NL>As Immortal Xu spoke up to this point, his voice sank,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gripped the hilt tightly, his knuckles turning white, bitterness surging in his heart...
64f91d5f-76bf-4f0f-b5c2-5d129718bc0b/Eve.cn: “莫非……<NL>焕心女娃也早已看出这十二邪物的门道，这才……”<NL><NL>徐仙公言至此处，语声一沉，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />握紧剑柄，指节泛白，心中悲苦翻涌……

64f91d5f-76bf-4f0f-b5c2-5d129718bc0b/Opt.en: In any case... the urgent task is to subdue the twelve evil beings and rescue Huanxin...
64f91d5f-76bf-4f0f-b5c2-5d129718bc0b/Opt.cn: 无论如何……当务之急，便是降伏十二邪物，救出焕心……
64f91d5f-76bf-4f0f-b5c2-5d129718bc0b/Opt.ru: В любом случае... неотложная задача состоит в том, чтобы подчинить себе двенадцать злых существ и спасти Хуаньсинь...

4837b9e2-4fbf-4a26-93eb-e0cfe2d41b87/Eve.en: "Benefactor, there is no time to lose..."<NL>Shishufu's expression was solemn, he immediately pressed his palms together and bowed, his voice resounding:<NL>"This old monk is willing to accompany you, benefactor, and set off immediately to subdue the demons!"
4837b9e2-4fbf-4a26-93eb-e0cfe2d41b87/Eve.cn: “施主，此事刻不容缓……”<NL>室述辅眉目肃然，当即合掌一拜，语声铿锵道：<NL>“老衲愿随施主同行，即刻启程，前往降伏妖魔！”
4837b9e2-4fbf-4a26-93eb-e0cfe2d41b87/Eve.ru: "Благодетель, нельзя терять ни минуты..."<NL>Выражение лица Шишуфу было серьезным, он немедленно сложил ладони вместе и поклонился, его голос звучал звучно:<NL>"Этот старый Монах готов сопровождать вас, благодетель, и немедленно отправиться покорять демонов!"

0c48ed7d-5984-48a3-b8a7-4a604ff4bc17/Eve.en: Before <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> could answer, everyone had already stepped forward in unison,<NL>cupping their hands, declaring they were willing to follow <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s Command, and go separately to subdue the twelve evil beings!
0c48ed7d-5984-48a3-b8a7-4a604ff4bc17/Eve.cn: 不等<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />答话，众人更已齐齐踏前一步，<NL>纷纷拱手，只道愿听<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />调遣，分头前去降伏那十二邪物！
0c48ed7d-5984-48a3-b8a7-4a604ff4bc17/Eve.ru: До того, как <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> мог ответить, все уже дружно шагнули вперед,<NL>сложив ладони рупором, они заявили, что готовы следовать <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />Командуйте и идите поодиночке, чтобы усмирить двенадцать злых существ!

06b8d2fa-d40c-4547-9adc-f6f2c4477f7b/Eve.en: Only Lei Ruosheng's voice is heard, resolute as metal and stone, vowing not to return without slaying the evil; <NL>Ran Xindu and Liuli hear this, their hearts surged, and they respond in unison with cheers; <NL><ArgBox key=BlackSnake type=string/> says nothing, but determination already burns in his eyes; <NL>Jade Cicada speaks softly of his resolve, willing to venture into danger with the group; <NL>White Ape and Mystic Bai stand still as mountains, not a trace of fear on their brows, clearly having long put life and death aside; <NL><NL>Finally, Jixi steps forward slowly and gently takes <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s hand,<NL>A thousand words are all hidden in those clear and bright eyes...
06b8d2fa-d40c-4547-9adc-f6f2c4477f7b/Eve.cn: 只闻雷若生声如金石，立誓不斩妖邪，绝不归返；<NL>苒心毒与琉璃听罢，心潮翻涌，更是齐声应和，欢呼连连；<NL><ArgBox key=BlackSnake type=string/>虽不言语，眼底却已燃起决意；<NL>玉蝉轻语明志，愿与众人同赴险地；<NL>白猿与玄白二人静立如山，眉宇间毫无畏色，分明早将生死置之度外；<NL><NL>末了，姬穸缓步走近，轻轻握住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的手，<NL>千言万语，尽藏于一双澄澈眼眸之中……

06b8d2fa-d40c-4547-9adc-f6f2c4477f7b/Opt.en: (A surge of heroism in the chest, from now on marching forward fearlessly, with nothing left to fear...)
06b8d2fa-d40c-4547-9adc-f6f2c4477f7b/Opt.cn: （胸中豪气顿生，自此一往无前，再无所惧……）
06b8d2fa-d40c-4547-9adc-f6f2c4477f7b/Opt.ru: (Прилив героизма в груди, отныне бесстрашно шагающий вперед, которому больше нечего бояться...)

70950295-1e23-45b0-8cb9-10cde152e215/Eve.en: At that moment, everyone's spirits were high, their fervor boiling over,<NL>as if sharing a righteous heart, as if sharing life and death, with wind and clouds and valor all condensed in this single moment!
70950295-1e23-45b0-8cb9-10cde152e215/Eve.cn: 当下，众人豪气激荡，群情如沸，<NL>似有侠义同心，似有生死与共，风云意气，尽数凝聚在此一刻！
70950295-1e23-45b0-8cb9-10cde152e215/Eve.ru: В этот момент настроение у всех было приподнятое, их пыл зашкаливал,<NL>как будто разделяешь праведное сердце, как будто разделяешь жизнь и смерть, с ветром, облаками и Доблестью - все это сконцентрировано в этом единственном мгновении!

70950295-1e23-45b0-8cb9-10cde152e215/Opt.en: To share the same boat and journey together, what fear is there on the path to vanquish demons...
70950295-1e23-45b0-8cb9-10cde152e215/Opt.cn: 得与诸位同舟共赴，除魔之途，又有何惧……
70950295-1e23-45b0-8cb9-10cde152e215/Opt.ru: Если мы плывем в одной лодке и путешествуем вместе, то чего бояться на пути к победе над демонами?..

ee010f09-c950-4943-82fb-35fdb276c1a0/Eve.en: Seeing the courage of everyone, Immortal Xu,<NL>even with a wooden heart, could not help but be moved.<NL>He let out a long sigh, as if a thousand emotions were stuck in his throat, and after a long while finally managed to speak:<NL>"Enough, enough! You kids, at such a critical moment, you don't even care about your own lives?<NL>If so... if I were to make excuses again, wouldn't that be unsightly..."
ee010f09-c950-4943-82fb-35fdb276c1a0/Eve.cn: 徐仙公见众人这般义勇，<NL>便是木头心肠，也不禁为之动容。<NL>只听他长长一叹，似有千般感慨堵在喉间，半晌才勉强开口：<NL>“罢了罢了！你们这群娃娃，危急关头竟这般不顾自己性命？<NL>如此……老夫若再要推三阻四，岂不难看……”

ee010f09-c950-4943-82fb-35fdb276c1a0/Opt.en: Does Immortal Xu also wish to come along?
ee010f09-c950-4943-82fb-35fdb276c1a0/Opt.ru: Бессмертный Сюй тоже хочет пойти с нами?

6b8f8dc2-5b9a-45b0-9cb1-98db65ff8f43/Eve.en: "This matter is of great importance, so I... have no choice but to do this!<NL>However, I will only accompany little Taiwu; I won't go elsewhere,<NL>otherwise... it's not safe!"<NL><NL>Immortal Xu shook his head continuously as he spoke,<NL>but <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, hearing this "reluctant" speech, laughed heartily, no longer feeling any discomfort...
6b8f8dc2-5b9a-45b0-9cb1-98db65ff8f43/Eve.cn: “此事干系重大，老夫……也只好如此！<NL>不过，老夫只肯随太吾小娃同行，旁处可不去，<NL>否则……不大安全！”<NL><NL>徐仙公一边说着，一边不住摇头，<NL>然而<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />听得他这番“勉为其难”的说辞，却是朗声一笑，再无半分不好……

faf55613-750c-4957-a4ef-da77ddb6c5c0/Eve.en: And so, the decision was made:<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> would take Shishufu and Immortal Xu along, leading the way,<NL>while the others, following <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s Command, would patrol various places to subdue these twelve evil beings...
faf55613-750c-4957-a4ef-da77ddb6c5c0/Eve.cn: 如此这般，主意已定：<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />携室述辅与徐仙公相随，一路先行，<NL>其余众人依照<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />号令，分巡各处，降伏这十二个邪物……
faf55613-750c-4957-a4ef-da77ddb6c5c0/Eve.ru: Итак, решение было принято:<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> взял бы с собой Шишуфу и Бессмертного Сюя, указывая путь,<NL>в то время как остальные, следуя <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />его командование будет патрулировать различные места, чтобы усмирить этих двенадцать злых существ...

faf55613-750c-4957-a4ef-da77ddb6c5c0/Opt.en: The road ahead is perilous; take care, everyone...
faf55613-750c-4957-a4ef-da77ddb6c5c0/Opt.cn: 此番前路凶险，诸位多加小心……
faf55613-750c-4957-a4ef-da77ddb6c5c0/Opt.ru: Дорога впереди опасна; будьте осторожны, все...

b3611eed-8ed2-4a90-9a69-72d7bc0a51f6/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> finished speaking,<NL>and everyone bid farewell with reluctance, repeatedly urging each other,<NL>some clasped fists and patted shoulders, some cupped hands in salute, each sincere in feeling.<NL><NL>After that, everyone said that if <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> summoned them with the Seven-Star Iron Plate, even across a thousand mountains and rivers, they would surely respond!<NL>Their words were full of mutual loyalty and trust, entrusting life and death to one another...
b3611eed-8ed2-4a90-9a69-72d7bc0a51f6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />话语将尽，<NL>众人依依惜别，彼此再三叮嘱，<NL>或抱拳拍肩，或拱手作别，各各情真意切。<NL><NL>此后众人更道，若<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />以七元铁盘相召，纵隔千山万水，亦当感之必应！<NL>言语之间，尽是肝胆相照、生死相托之意……

6686a2ce-d33f-46aa-822c-d2917e9536fd/Eve.en: The situation was urgent, so no one delayed any longer.<NL>After bidding each other farewell, they prepared to set off.<NL>They saw <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gently stroking the "Fuyu Hilt", sensing the locations of the twelve evil beings, and pointing out the directions one by one for everyone.<NL>Everyone said "Take care" in unison, then went their separate ways, rushing swiftly toward the places indicated by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />.<NL><NL>Outside the Taiwu Ancestral Temple, the wind howled, figures gradually faded into the distance,<NL>leaving only faint residual light, illuminating the road ahead...
6686a2ce-d33f-46aa-822c-d2917e9536fd/Eve.cn: 事态紧迫，众人不再耽搁，<NL>各自辞别，便要动身而去。<NL>只见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />轻抚「伏虞剑柄」，感应着那十二邪物所在，一一为众人指明方位，<NL>而众人齐道一声“珍重”，随即各奔东西，朝着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />所指之处疾行而去。<NL><NL>太吾祠堂之外，风声四起，人影渐远，<NL>唯余残光淡淡，映照前路……

6686a2ce-d33f-46aa-822c-d2917e9536fd/Opt.en: (Set out to subdue the twelve evil beings and rescue Huanxin...)
6686a2ce-d33f-46aa-822c-d2917e9536fd/Opt.cn: （前往降伏十二邪物，救出焕心……）
6686a2ce-d33f-46aa-822c-d2917e9536fd/Opt.ru: (Отправился покорять двенадцать злых существ и спасать Хуаньсинь...)

e3960c77-5cb7-43b1-8e81-01e599494293/Eve.en: The heavens and earth are vast, demons plague the world,<NL>all burdens fall upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s shoulders,<NL>yet the path ahead is clear, this journey will be fearless,<NL>to subdue the twelve evil beings and bring Huanxin back,<NL>to gather with heroes from across the world, to eradicate the Xiangshu demon,<NL><NL>and restore this mortal world to a bright and clear Pure Brightness!
e3960c77-5cb7-43b1-8e81-01e599494293/Eve.cn: 天地苍茫，妖魔祸世，<NL>万般干系皆担于<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />肩上，<NL>然而前路已明，此行一往无前，<NL>降伏十二邪物，救得焕心归来，<NL>会合天下群英，除灭相枢妖魔，<NL><NL>还此间尘世一片朗朗乾坤，清明天地！

e3960c77-5cb7-43b1-8e81-01e599494293/Opt.en: (No time to lose, set off immediately!)

217bdf4c-eac2-4dae-9a97-f4b9072a5ec9/Eve.en: Lei Ruosheng, holding a long blade, was leaning sideways against the table,<NL>and when he saw <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> looking his way, he raised an eyebrow and revealed a confident smile:<NL>"That battle at Mt. Chai was perilous! I'm glad you came out Unharmed; that stone has finally been lifted from my heart.<NL>Now that you're going to slay demons and eradicate the Xiangshu, such a grand feat, I must follow you and witness it myself!"<NL><NL>At this, his eyes blazed and his voice grew even more resolute:<NL>"Taiwu, of all the great heroes under heaven, you are the only one I, Lei Ruosheng, recognize!"
217bdf4c-eac2-4dae-9a97-f4b9072a5ec9/Eve.cn: 雷若生怀抱长刀，正斜倚桌案，<NL>见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />望来，方才眉梢轻扬，展露一抹笃定的笑意：<NL>“此前柴山一战好生凶险！幸而你安然无恙，我心头这块石头才算落了地。<NL>此番你既要去斩妖除魔，诛灭相枢，这般壮举，我定要随你同往，亲眼见证一番才是！”<NL><NL>说到此处，他目光灼灼，语声愈发铿锵：<NL>“太吾，这世间顶天立地的大侠，我雷若生只认你一人！”

e78dc5b0-1683-4192-8fda-c00ca9476b66/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s gaze swept to not far away,<NL>where Hua Ju, Xuan Zhi, and Ying Jiao were huddled together, chattering noisily, seemingly arguing about something.<NL>Hua Ju was holding a cup of hot tea in his hand, muttering to himself:<NL>"My master has just awakened from serious injury, so warm tea is best for the body! You two, step aside and don't block my way..."
e78dc5b0-1683-4192-8fda-c00ca9476b66/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />目光扫向不远处，<NL>只见华居、玄质、迎娇三人凑作一团，此刻正叽叽喳喳，不知在争些什么。<NL>那华居手中似是捧着一盏热茶，口中念念有词道：<NL>“师父重伤初醒，自是热茶暖身才好！你二人且让一让，勿要阻我去路……”

332aae6a-5ca9-4f07-85a3-bed3d06f686a/Eve.en: But Xuan Zhi carried a flask of Fine Wine,<NL>dodging left and right, nimble in movement, chattering incessantly:<NL>"No, no! When slaying demons and vanquishing evil, fighting to one's heart's content, how can one be in a good mood without wine to accompany?<NL>You'd better put away that hot tea!"<NL><NL>As he spoke, his brows danced with delight,<NL>the wine flask swaying in his hand without spilling a drop, truly a carefree sight...
332aae6a-5ca9-4f07-85a3-bed3d06f686a/Eve.cn: 但见玄质手提一壶好酒，<NL>左闪右避，身形灵动，口中嚷嚷不休：<NL>“非也非也！那斩妖除魔，斗得酣畅淋漓，要想心情舒畅，怎能无酒相陪？<NL>你这热茶，还是趁早收起来罢！”<NL><NL>说话间，他眉飞色舞，<NL>酒壶在手中晃来晃去，滴酒未洒，端的是一副潇洒模样……

f1a66810-9537-4f66-b655-627469f95dc4/Eve.en: Ying Jiao, however, stepped back half a pace,<NL>watching the two bicker endlessly, gently shaking her head with a tone of reproach:<NL>"You two are so noisy; at least let the master rest in peace..."<NL>Having said this, she smiled slightly and sighed softly:<NL>"Alas, the master has so many old friends, relatives, and confidantes by his side. This journey of slaying demons and vanquishing evil,<NL>I'm afraid it will be exceptionally lively..."
f1a66810-9537-4f66-b655-627469f95dc4/Eve.cn: 迎娇却退开半步，<NL>只瞧着二人争闹不休，轻轻摇头，语带嗔意：<NL>“你们这般吵吵闹闹，好歹叫师父安生歇一歇才是……”<NL>说至此处，却又微微一笑，低声叹道：<NL>“唉，师父身边竟有这许多亲朋旧友、红颜知己。这降妖除魔的一路，<NL>只怕定是热闹非凡了……”

28adef75-d317-42bb-8bc5-8c2967378fe2/Eve.en: Jade Cicada had already put away her weapon, holding a cup of warm tea in her hand, with a contemplative expression.<NL>A moment later, she parted her lips lightly and spoke in a calm voice:<NL>"Life and death of humans, between heaven and earth, is but a flicker of a finger; but those demons have been rampaging for long, as if to live as long as heaven and earth...<NL>If one is to slay demons and vanquish evil with a mortal body, and return the world to a state of Pure Brightness..."<NL><NL>Jade Cicada paused, turned to face <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, her expression calm and resolute:<NL><NL>"In this world, there is no one else capable of this task besides you.<NL>Taiwu, I will definitely accompany you on this path of vanquishing evil..."
28adef75-d317-42bb-8bc5-8c2967378fe2/Eve.cn: 玉蝉早已收了兵刃，手中捧着一杯温茶，神色若有所思。<NL>片刻，却听她轻轻启唇，语声淡淡道：<NL>“人之生死，于这天地之间，不过弹指一瞬，那妖魔却肆虐已久，仿佛要与天地同寿……<NL>若要以凡人之躯斩妖除魔，还世间一片清明……”<NL><NL>玉蝉顿了顿，转头朝向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，神色沉静而笃定：<NL><NL>“这世间能为此事者，除你之外，再无旁人。<NL>太吾，这除魔之路，我是一定要随你去的……”

8cddd4c6-b12f-407b-b630-2563730875cb/Eve.en: White Ape, leaning on his staff, slowly stepped forward,<NL>gently stroking his beard as he looked at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, his expression very reassuring:<NL>"Young friend, you are well, I see... This old man sees that you have become even more extraordinary in bearing, which puts my heart at ease...<NL>The many Demons in Mt. Emei all think of you fondly; before I left, they repeatedly entrusted me,<NL>telling me to record all your deeds of slaying demons and vanquishing evil, bring them back to the mountain, and tell them to the others..."
8cddd4c6-b12f-407b-b630-2563730875cb/Eve.cn: 白猿拄着拐杖，缓步近前，<NL>只见他轻轻抚须，望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，神色甚是宽慰：<NL>“小友别来无恙……老朽见小友如今愈发气度不凡，心中倒也踏实万分……<NL>峨眉山中那一众妖族，心中俱是挂念小友，临行前再三托付，<NL>只叫老朽定要将你斩妖除魔的种种事迹记下来，带回山去，讲给他们听呢……”

bd188c4c-fcbe-4110-adbc-4eb5bf3a30ca/Eve.en: Xuan Wuyou chuckled happily, looking at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, his voice still unhurried:<NL>"Although this matter of slaying demons and vanquishing evil is fraught with dangers... you need not worry,<NL>with Unharmed and me here, there is nothing to fear..."<NL>As he spoke, his brows relaxed, exuding an air of calm...
bd188c4c-fcbe-4110-adbc-4eb5bf3a30ca/Eve.cn: 玄无忧乐呵呵一笑，望着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，声音还是那般不急不缓：<NL>“这斩妖除魔之事，虽说千难万险……你却也莫要忧心，<NL>有我与无恙在此，便没什么可惧的了……”<NL>说话间，他眉眼舒展，一派从容……

7eb672bd-77f1-4cfc-a24c-720e8360f79c/Eve.en: And then Bai Wuyang's eyes sparkled, as she glanced at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and let out a giggle,<NL>her laughter crisp and clear, like a silver bell tinkling.<NL>She said with confidence:<NL>"You want to slay that Xiangshu demon; how can this battle lack our Valley of Flowers?<NL>With Carefree and me helping you, just go ahead and fight! No matter how dangerous the road ahead, no matter how severe the injuries, the two of us can heal you back..."
7eb672bd-77f1-4cfc-a24c-720e8360f79c/Eve.cn: 又见白无恙眼波流转，瞧着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，扑哧一笑，<NL>那笑声清清脆脆，如银铃轻摇。<NL>只听她胸有成竹道：<NL>“你要斩那相枢妖魔，这场较量，又怎能少了我们百花谷？<NL>有我与无忧助你，你只管放手去战！前路再险，再重的伤，我二人都能治得回来……”

ae7c7e13-f7a2-4a70-835d-487885b99e7b/Eve.en: <ArgBox key=BlackSnake type=string/> sat silently to one side,<NL>gazing fixedly at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> without blinking.<NL>When their eyes met, she couldn't help but softly speak, her voice low:<NL>"Now... everything is fine...<NL>If you go to that dangerous place again, sacrificing yourself to death, I will follow you...<NL>Whether it's slaying demons or vanquishing evil..."
ae7c7e13-f7a2-4a70-835d-487885b99e7b/Eve.cn: <ArgBox key=BlackSnake type=string/>默默坐于一侧，<NL>正目不转睛，定定望着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />。<NL>四目相对之际，她不由轻轻开口，语声低缓道：<NL>“如今……已是无事了……<NL>你若再去那险地，舍身赴死，吾便也随你同去……<NL>不管是斩妖，还是除魔……”

2215a359-5265-431a-a914-c78bedd6fd02/Eve.en: Ran Xindu put her hands on her hips, circling <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> and looking him up and down,<NL>examining him thoroughly for a good while, then suddenly broke into a smile, her eyes curving, and said cheerfully:<NL>"<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/> gave me such a fright, but now it's finally all right...<NL>Those Villainous are truly detestable; from now on I must go with you and beat them all away, okay?<NL><NL>No matter what, I'm sticking with you, so consider <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/> as having agreed..."
2215a359-5265-431a-a914-c78bedd6fd02/Eve.cn: 苒心毒双手叉腰，绕着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />左瞧右看，<NL>上上下下打量了好一阵，方才忽地一笑，眉眼弯弯，笑嘻嘻道：<NL>“<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>让我好生担惊受怕，如今总算是无事了……<NL>那些妖魔鬼怪实在可恶的很，以后我定要跟你一起去，将他们全部打跑，可好？<NL><NL>不管不管，我就是要跟的你，便当<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>答应啦……”

eb596d3d-d451-4ca2-99d8-cfdb7b54177d/Eve.en: But Liuli gazed intently, seeming to daydream about the road ahead while chattering endlessly:<NL><NL>"The day of annihilating Xiangshu is drawing nearer and nearer, I think...<NL>For some reason, I feel a tightness in my heart, and the more I think about it, the hungrier I get...<NL>Are you hungry? Want something to eat?"<NL><NL>As soon as he finished, his face reddened slightly, and turning to look at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, he shook his head with a laugh:<NL>"I forgot, you are already a towering hero, cutting through thorns and overcoming all obstacles, never flinching from such things.<NL>But right now... filling our stomachs is the priority..."
eb596d3d-d451-4ca2-99d8-cfdb7b54177d/Eve.cn: 却见琉璃目光殷殷，似在一边畅想前路，一边絮絮不休：<NL><NL>“诛灭相枢之日，想来已是越来越近……<NL>不知怎的，我竟觉着心头莫名发紧，越想，便越觉得有几分饥饿……<NL>你可饿了？可要吃点什么？”<NL><NL>话音刚落，他面上微微一红，转目望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，摇头笑道：<NL>“我竟忘了，你本就是顶天立地的大侠，披荆斩棘、所向披靡，何曾畏惧这些。<NL>只是眼下……还是先填饱肚子要紧……”

3b390f0e-a909-41ed-b846-1fb9aa4a2e06/Eve.en: Jixi never left his side, staying close to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />,<NL>She seemed deeply attached to the Taiwu Ancestral Temple, her gaze lingering over every part of the room, not withdrawing for a long time.<NL>Now seeing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> look at her, she smiled faintly and said softly:<NL>"Taiwu, Taiwu...<NL>Lifelong Oath, cannot ask Heaven...<NL>This heavy task of slaying demons and vanquishing evil, though borne on your shoulders alone, there are always people by your side willing to walk with you.<NL><NL>Say no more. I have lived with you, and if it's to die, I will surely die with you..."
3b390f0e-a909-41ed-b846-1fb9aa4a2e06/Eve.cn: 姬穸始终寸步不离，相伴<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />身侧，<NL>她似对太吾祠堂眷恋颇深，目光流连屋内各处，久久不曾收回。<NL>此刻见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />望来，她便微微一笑，轻声说道：<NL>“太吾太吾……<NL>死生契阔，不可问天……<NL>这斩妖除魔的重任，虽说是你一肩担负，然你身侧，总有人愿与你并肩而行。<NL><NL>你莫要多言，我既与你同生，若是死，也定是要与你同死的……”

7c56dbd0-61c4-46bf-8c64-c30a4cd12257/Eve.en: White Ape spoke first, answering unhurriedly:<NL>"Ever since the young friend returned from that Otherland,<NL>Grandmaster Shishufu has been traveling around, visiting each of us one by one,<NL>saying only that Huanxin has been rescued by you, the time has come, and he invites us to join hands and come out, to help Taiwu annihilate Xiangshu..."
7c56dbd0-61c4-46bf-8c64-c30a4cd12257/Eve.cn: 白猿当先开口，悠悠答道：<NL>“自打小友从那出神之地归来，<NL>室述辅大师便四下奔走，逐一寻访我等，<NL>只道焕心已被小友救回，时机已到，愿邀我等携手而出，共助太吾诛灭相枢……”

7c56dbd0-61c4-46bf-8c64-c30a4cd12257/Opt.en: (So after parting in that Illusion that day, Grandmaster Shishufu had already set out to visit everyone...)
7c56dbd0-61c4-46bf-8c64-c30a4cd12257/Opt.cn: （原来当日幻境一别，室述辅大师便已动身寻访诸位……）
7c56dbd0-61c4-46bf-8c64-c30a4cd12257/Opt.ru: (Итак, расставшись в тот день с этой Иллюзией, гроссмейстер Шишуфу уже отправился навестить всех...)

4c002d80-28af-468e-add0-6b848d0528b9/Eve.en: After White Ape finished, everyone nodded and started chattering to clarify the matter.<NL><NL>Only Bai Wuyang let out a soft laugh, raised an eyebrow, and continued:<NL>"When we heard this time it was to help Taiwu eradicate Xiangshu, how could we have any excuse to refuse?<NL>We immediately set off with Grandmaster Shishufu and rushed here to help."
4c002d80-28af-468e-add0-6b848d0528b9/Eve.cn: 白猿说罢，众人皆是颔首，七嘴八舌欲将此事说清。<NL><NL>只听得白无恙轻声一笑，挑眉续道：<NL>“听闻此番是要助太吾铲除相枢，既是如此，我等又岂有推托之理？<NL>当即便随室述辅大师拔足启程，赶来相助啦。”

3719b88b-5432-411a-9732-5f8dce0b88dc/Eve.en: <ArgBox key=BlackSnake type=string/> stood silently aside, her gaze deep,<NL>falling upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, and after a long while, only uttered a low sentence:<NL>"Grandmaster Shishufu said that the Seven-Star Iron Plate sent him a warning that a great calamity would befall you at Mt. Chai,<NL>so I came to share your worries and solve your troubles... Seeing you safe, my heart is finally at ease."
3719b88b-5432-411a-9732-5f8dce0b88dc/Eve.cn: <ArgBox key=BlackSnake type=string/>默然立在一旁，目光幽幽，<NL>落在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />身上，半晌，只低低吐出一句：<NL>“室述辅大师言，七元铁盘向他传去预警，你于柴山有大祸将至，<NL>吾便赶来，为你分忧解难……见你无事，吾心终安。”

f7efb25a-f00f-48ec-8e7d-371be3db3538/Eve.en: "Indeed! Hearing this, how could we sit idly by?"<NL>Lei Ruosheng recalled that day, furrowing his brows slightly, and mused with arms crossed:<NL>"Grandmaster Shishufu made a prompt decision and led us to Mt. Chai to rush to your rescue.<NL>Traveling day and night like this, when we finally arrived at Mt. Chai, we saw Immortal Xu standing alone by the sea, pacing back and forth,<NL>looking like he had been waiting for a long time!"
f7efb25a-f00f-48ec-8e7d-371be3db3538/Eve.cn: “不错！既闻此事，我等安能再坐以待毙？”<NL>雷若生忆及当日，不由眉头微锁，环臂沉吟道：<NL>“室述辅大师当机立断，率我等奔赴柴山，赶往相救。<NL>如此一路兼程，待得抵达柴山，果然在海边撞见徐仙公孤身伫立，往复徘徊，<NL>看那样子，分明已等了许久！”

57d2afb9-9fae-459b-a3c4-d27fdf226470/Eve.en: Ran Xindu, upon hearing this,<NL>rushed forward and grabbed <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s arm,<NL>her eyes slightly red, her voice urgent and crisp:<NL>"At that time, the old Immortal told us that <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/> had been trapped by an extremely powerful enemy,<NL>I was so anxious when I heard this, I wished I could rush over to save you..."
57d2afb9-9fae-459b-a3c4-d27fdf226470/Eve.cn: 苒心毒听至此处，<NL>更是扑上前来，一把拉住<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />的手臂，<NL>眼眶微红，声音又急又脆：<NL>“那时候，老仙公跟我们讲，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=GenderRanXinduSpecial/>已被一个极厉害的强敌困住啦，<NL>我听了这话，心里面好生焦急，恨不得赶点前去救你……”

c2a0ec17-4d49-4158-94af-08aecfdb508b/Eve.en: Jade Cicada had been standing quietly by the side, and couldn't help but let out a soft sigh, her voice gentle:<NL>"By the time we arrived, Immortal Xu, seeing that reinforcements had arrived,<NL>hesitated no longer and immediately led the way, guiding us deep into Mt. Chai to the Divine Furnace ruins to find you..."
c2a0ec17-4d49-4158-94af-08aecfdb508b/Eve.cn: 玉蝉始终静立在旁，此刻也不禁低低一叹，语声轻柔道：<NL>“彼时我等既已赶到，徐仙公见援手已至，<NL>便也不再踌躇，当即开路，引我等深入柴山，去那神炉遗迹寻你所在……”

a1cc4b1c-95fa-4ec2-b388-92268f37e7a4/Eve.en: Liuli still seemed to harbor some lingering fear,<NL>He remained close by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, raising a hand to lightly pat his chest, speaking slowly:<NL>"When we reached the Divine Furnace ruins, we immediately followed Grandmaster Shishufu into that strange crack,<NL>and finally, at the critical moment, we managed to rescue you, snatching you back from the danger..."<NL><NL>Even so, a trace of hidden worry still lingered between his brows, long unresolved...
a1cc4b1c-95fa-4ec2-b388-92268f37e7a4/Eve.cn: 琉璃心底似还余着几分惊惧，<NL>他仍守在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />近旁，抬手轻拍胸口，缓声开口：<NL>“及至神炉遗迹，我等立时便随室述辅大师，钻入那道古怪裂缝，<NL>总算赶在紧要关头，将你救下，从险境之中夺了回来……”<NL><NL>话虽如此，他眉间却仍藏着一缕隐忧，久久未曾消散……

cc9c1112-85fc-4aff-817c-1cd9410df8ae/Eve.en: Shishufu took over the conversation and answered slowly:<NL>"In ancient times, when heaven and earth first opened and all things flourished,<NL>there were twelve Celestial Immortals who attained the Tao on Kunlun, together maintaining the cause and effect of the world and jointly governing the order of heaven and earth..."
cc9c1112-85fc-4aff-817c-1cd9410df8ae/Eve.cn: 室述辅接过话头，缓声解答道：<NL>“上古之时，天地初开，万物生发，<NL>曾有十二位上仙于昆仑得道，一同维系世间因果，共掌天地秩序……”

9aba1f90-569b-4091-bdcc-0d751d1c995a/Eve.en: "However... after Xiangshu escaped from the Guyao Divine Furnace,<NL>that demon intended to erode and shake this realm of heaven and earth, so the twelve Celestial Immortals were disturbed by it day by day, their powers waning, their radiance gradually dimming.<NL>Until they helped Tainted forge the first 'Fuyu Sword', the immortals then vanished without a trace for unknown reasons, never to appear again..."
9aba1f90-569b-4091-bdcc-0d751d1c995a/Eve.cn: “然而……自相枢逃出梏妖神炉之后，<NL>那妖魔意图侵蚀动摇此方天地，十二位上仙便日日受其侵扰，法力渐衰，光华也日渐黯淡。<NL>直至助染尘子铸成最初的「伏虞剑」，诸仙便不知何故，一并失了踪影，再未现世……”

9aba1f90-569b-4091-bdcc-0d751d1c995a/Opt.en: The twelve Celestial Immortals disappeared without a trace...
9aba1f90-569b-4091-bdcc-0d751d1c995a/Opt.cn: 十二上仙就此消失无踪……

0fa9f3fe-688e-4ba3-8f6b-817651c30eca/Eve.en: After listening to Shishufu's words, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> carefully recalled his past experiences and couldn't help but guess:<NL><NL>The twelve Celestial Immortals had once worked together to forge the 'Fuyu Sword',<NL>and after the sword was completed, they suddenly disappeared.<NL>Was it related to those twelve black lights...<NL><NL>Could it be... that the evil power of the Xiangshu was so strong that<NL>even the twelve Celestial Immortals could not resist, becoming Possessed and turning into twelve dark lights...
0fa9f3fe-688e-4ba3-8f6b-817651c30eca/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />听罢室述辅所言，细细回想此前经历，心中不免横生猜测：<NL><NL>十二上仙曾齐心协力铸就「伏虞剑」，<NL>剑成之后，却突然消失，<NL>是否与那十二道黑光有所关联……<NL><NL>莫非……相枢的邪力当真强横至此，<NL>纵使十二上仙也无法抵抗，入魔化作了十二道邪光……

0fa9f3fe-688e-4ba3-8f6b-817651c30eca/Opt.en: Could it be that the twelve Celestial Immortals fell into the demonic path and turned into twelve evil lights?
0fa9f3fe-688e-4ba3-8f6b-817651c30eca/Opt.cn: 莫非，是那十二位上仙堕入魔道，化作了十二道邪光？
0fa9f3fe-688e-4ba3-8f6b-817651c30eca/Opt.ru: Могло ли быть так, что двенадцать Небесных Бессмертных встали на демонический путь и превратились в двенадцать злых огней?

d13f6756-78cd-494a-8b68-76507ee83a1c/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> voiced this doubt,<NL>but saw Shishufu slowly shake his head, his voice growing heavier:<NL>"Where the twelve Celestial Immortals actually went, this old monk has searched the world over and still knows nothing.<NL>However... I unexpectedly discovered one thing in the process..."<NL><NL>After saying this, he paused, his gaze dropping slightly, as if weighing how to begin...
d13f6756-78cd-494a-8b68-76507ee83a1c/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />将此疑问道出，<NL>却见室述辅缓缓摇头，语声愈发沉重：<NL>“十二上仙究竟去向何方，老衲遍访世间，仍是一无所知。<NL>只是……其间竟意外察觉一事……”<NL><NL>说罢，他顿了一顿，目光微垂，似在斟酌如何开口……

24e6c816-0296-48b2-a2fb-5abb0fd89d39/Eve.en: "At that time, this old monk discovered that in the dark corners of the world, twelve evil beings were lurking...<NL><NL>Those twelve evil beings had been dormant for many years, but since Miss Huanxin was rescued by the benefactor from the Abyss,<NL>these twelve evil beings revived one by one. It seems they were driven by Xiangshu, intending to join the Ancestor of Mt. Chai,<NL>to Snatch the Divine Stone that stabilizes the world, kill Nianhui Taiwu, and then capture Miss Huanxin's soul back...<NL><NL>But now, Huanxin has used her own strength to Distract them all at Mt. Chai..."
24e6c816-0296-48b2-a2fb-5abb0fd89d39/Eve.cn: “其时，老衲发觉世间暗处，竟蛰伏着十二邪物……<NL><NL>那十二邪物本已沉寂多年，自焕心姑娘被施主救出玄狱之后，<NL>这十二邪物竟一一复生，想来应是受了相枢驱使，欲与柴山元祖一道，<NL>夺取镇界神石，诛杀念回太吾，再将焕心姑娘的元神捉拿回去……<NL><NL>只是如今，焕心又以一己之力，将他们尽数牵制在了柴山……”

24e6c816-0296-48b2-a2fb-5abb0fd89d39/Opt.en: Huanxin... (a pang of pain in my heart...)

d8045822-0313-4fd0-badf-4aaeb3ddee3b/Eve.en: Immortal Xu sighed upon hearing this and then chimed in:<NL><NL>"In my opinion, these twelve evil beings<NL>are the very dharma treasures that the twelve Celestial Immortals relied on in the past.<NL>After being long contaminated by the Xiangshu's Demonic Qi, they fell into evil,<NL>took on human form, lurked in the mundane world, absorbing worldly suffering to sustain the invincible body of the Ancestor of Mt. Chai..."
d8045822-0313-4fd0-badf-4aaeb3ddee3b/Eve.cn: 徐仙公闻言一叹，接口说道：<NL><NL>“依老夫所见，这十二邪物，<NL>便是十二上仙昔日的立身法宝，<NL>因久受相枢魔气侵染，这才堕为妖邪，<NL>化作人形，潜伏尘世，汲取世间苦难，维系柴山元祖不败之身……”

d8045822-0313-4fd0-badf-4aaeb3ddee3b/Opt.en: (If we eliminate these twelve evil beings...)
d8045822-0313-4fd0-badf-4aaeb3ddee3b/Opt.ru: (Если мы уничтожим эти двенадцать злых существ...)

c2650e67-746d-407f-a7ec-504b8e39f2f8/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> pondered for a moment,<NL>carefully weighing the words of the two in his mind, gradually sorting things out:<NL>If he could exterminate those twelve evil beings, not only could he completely eliminate the Ancestor of Mt. Chai, but he could also dissolve the twelve black lights entangled with Huanxin.<NL>Once the black lights disperse, Huanxin can naturally break free and see the light of day again...
c2650e67-746d-407f-a7ec-504b8e39f2f8/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />细思片刻，<NL>将二人所言在心中反复推敲，渐渐理出头绪：<NL>若能诛灭那十二邪物，不仅可将柴山元祖彻底除去，更能消解那与焕心纠缠的十二道黑光。<NL>一旦黑光散尽，焕心自可脱困，重见天日……

c2650e67-746d-407f-a7ec-504b8e39f2f8/Opt.en: If these twelve evil beings can be eliminated, then Huanxin can be rescued? (Speaking one's thoughts...)
c2650e67-746d-407f-a7ec-504b8e39f2f8/Opt.cn: 若能除去这十二个邪物，便可救出焕心？（道出所思……）
c2650e67-746d-407f-a7ec-504b8e39f2f8/Opt.ru: Если эти двенадцать злых существ могут быть уничтожены, то Хуаньсинь может быть спасена? (Высказывая свои мысли...)

aca52e8e-3d7b-4ef6-ad9f-56cc7687db14/Eve.en: Shishufu’s eyes showed approval, and he gently nodded before continuing unhurriedly: <NL>“Not only that… these twelve evil beings are in fact the source of many Misdeeds in the mortal world. <NL>If they can be completely eradicated, people’s hearts will be a bit clearer, and the world will have a little less Hostility. <NL>Xiangshu, losing its nourishment, will weaken with each loss; <NL>Then, Benefactor, when you eliminate the demon, you will have a greater chance of victory…”
aca52e8e-3d7b-4ef6-ad9f-56cc7687db14/Eve.cn: 室述辅目露赞许，轻轻颔首，又徐徐续道：<NL>“非但如此……此十二邪物，实乃人世诸多恶业之源。<NL>若能将之尽数铲除，天下人心便可多一分清朗，世间亦少一分戾气，<NL>相枢失其滋养一分，便将力衰一分；<NL>届时施主除魔，便更多出几分胜算……”

aca52e8e-3d7b-4ef6-ad9f-56cc7687db14/Opt.en: So it is imperative to eliminate these twelve evil beings…
aca52e8e-3d7b-4ef6-ad9f-56cc7687db14/Opt.cn: 如此说来，除去十二个邪物乃是势在必行……
aca52e8e-3d7b-4ef6-ad9f-56cc7687db14/Opt.ru: Поэтому крайне важно уничтожить эти двенадцать злых существ…

fed6e100-284f-472d-9303-7d624a9d2b8e/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> raised his head and looked around at the old friends in the room, <NL>seeing familiar faces, some with blazing eyes, some with calm expressions, <NL>all full of sincere friendship and high spirits. <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> felt a surge of warmth and finally understood: <NL><NL>Every single person here was willing to give their all for <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, <NL>but each had limited cultivation and insufficient power, so they had never been able to achieve complete success before. <NL>And those treasures left by the twelve Celestial Immortals were indispensable aids in eliminating the demon. <NL>Knowing this, and with their hearts tied to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, they were of course willing to risk their lives to go and subdue those twelve evil beings…
fed6e100-284f-472d-9303-7d624a9d2b8e/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />抬起头来，复又望向满屋旧友，<NL>但见一张张熟悉的面孔，或目光灼灼，或神色坦然，<NL>皆是情谊拳拳、踌躇满志，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />当即心头一热，终于了然：<NL><NL>此间众人，竟是无一不愿为<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />披肝沥胆，<NL>奈何各人修为有限，力有不逮，此前始终难竟全功。<NL>而那十二上仙所遗之宝，实为除魔不可或缺之助力，<NL>众人既知此事，心系<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />，自是甘愿拼死一搏，前去降伏那十二邪物……

fed6e100-284f-472d-9303-7d624a9d2b8e/Opt.en: (To eliminate the twelve evil beings, I will need everyone’s help…)
fed6e100-284f-472d-9303-7d624a9d2b8e/Opt.cn: （欲除十二邪物，少不得诸位出手相助……）
fed6e100-284f-472d-9303-7d624a9d2b8e/Opt.ru: (Чтобы уничтожить двенадцать злых существ, мне понадобится помощь каждого...)

284b106c-f2bc-4caf-8b9f-c386d82b2a7b/Eve.en: Long Yufu was startled by the sight, and quickly patted <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> on the back: <NL>“This loong’s blood is quite rare. If you vomit it out, it would be a waste of a precious thing!” <NL><NL>Upon hearing this, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> slightly circulated his Inner Breath, <NL>and indeed his breathing became much Unimpeded, and the tightness in his chest eased a bit…
284b106c-f2bc-4caf-8b9f-c386d82b2a7b/Eve.cn: 龙语茯见状一惊，忙是用力连抚<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />后背：<NL>“这虬龙血颇不常见，你若呕了出来可就暴殄天物了！”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />听闻此言，略一运转内息，<NL>气息果然顺畅了不少，胸口的滞闷也散去几分……

a8dae454-98fe-47b6-af95-b0d8a8eeba45/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> slowly propped himself up and looked around. <NL>He saw carved beams hung high, walls painted vermilion, fresh offerings of green fruits, and faint wisps of incense smoke. <NL>It was the rear hall of the Taiwu Ancestral Temple… <NL><NL>Long Yufu sat sideways on the edge of the bed, holding a celadon bowl. <NL>When she saw <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> awake, the fatigue in her brows had not yet faded, but she could not hide her joy. <NL>Nearby against the wall, three Dispassionate Ones, who had been resting with their eyes closed, heard the commotion, <NL>quickly got up and came to the bedside, bowing together to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />…
a8dae454-98fe-47b6-af95-b0d8a8eeba45/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />缓缓撑起身子，环顾四周，<NL>但见雕梁高悬，四壁朱红，供果青青，烟气寥寥，<NL>竟是太吾祠堂的后殿……<NL><NL>龙语茯侧坐榻边，手捧青瓷碗，<NL>见得<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />醒来，眉目间倦色未褪，却仍难掩欣喜，<NL>一旁靠墙处，三名无念众本自闭目歇息，听得动静，<NL>连忙起身行至榻前，朝<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />齐齐躬身一拜……

a8dae454-98fe-47b6-af95-b0d8a8eeba45/Opt.en: You arrived in time, but how did you find your way to Mt. Chai?
a8dae454-98fe-47b6-af95-b0d8a8eeba45/Opt.cn: 你们来得及时，却不知如何寻至柴山？
a8dae454-98fe-47b6-af95-b0d8a8eeba45/Opt.ru: Вы прибыли вовремя, но как вы нашли дорогу на гору Чай?

a8dae454-98fe-47b6-af95-b0d8a8eeba45/Opt.en: Dispassionate Ones… why are there only three of you left? Where are the others?
a8dae454-98fe-47b6-af95-b0d8a8eeba45/Opt.cn: 无念众……何以只剩你三人……其余人何在？
a8dae454-98fe-47b6-af95-b0d8a8eeba45/Opt.ru: Бесстрастные… почему вас осталось только трое? Где остальные?

02ae4987-8491-4813-ac41-4ce9c1436439/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> swept his gaze over the three Dispassionate Ones in front of him, and could not help asking… <NL><NL>One of the Dispassionate Ones immediately stepped forward, cupped his hands, and replied: <NL>“The Mt. Chai Ancestor is accompanied by twelve black lights that scatter and then gather again, making them truly difficult to fight. <NL>We suffered heavy casualties, ultimately losing six people… Until…” <NL><NL>When the man reached this point, everyone’s expressions dimmed, and they fell silent…
02ae4987-8491-4813-ac41-4ce9c1436439/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />扫过身前三名无念众，不由问道……<NL><NL>一名无念众闻言，当即上前一步，拱手作答：<NL>“柴山元祖有十二道黑光傍身，散而复聚，实难力敌，<NL>我等伤亡惨重，最终折损了六人……直到……”<NL><NL>那人言至此处，众人尽皆神情一黯，默然不语……

dc6acdf7-ccfb-4052-94b2-4fcf5d73d33a/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> sensed something was wrong and was about to press further, <NL>when he heard Immortal Xu’s voice coming from outside the hall: <NL><NL>“Until, the girl Huanxin, in order to protect our escape, <NL>went to face danger, and alone blocked those twelve black lights, entangling with them, <NL>thus… mutually distracting each other, neither able to do anything to the other…”
dc6acdf7-ccfb-4052-94b2-4fcf5d73d33a/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心知不妙，正要追问，<NL>只听徐仙公的声音从殿外传来：<NL><NL>“直到，焕心女娃为护我等脱身，<NL>赴险而去，竟独自挡下那十二道黑光，与之纠缠一处，<NL>如此……彼此牵制，谁也奈何不了谁……”

1512a4b5-e80a-487b-bd18-a74142dc3688/Eve.en: Before the voice had finished, Immortal Xu and the Incarnation of Nianzhili walked in side by side from outside the hall. <NL>Immortal Xu’s gaze fell upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, and even though his face was made of wood, he could not help showing sorrow: <NL><NL>“It is precisely because the girl Huanxin sacrificed herself to protect us… <NL>that this time we could escape smoothly with the little Taiwu child, making a Narrow Escape… <NL>That girl believes in her heart that if it is the little Taiwu child, he will surely find a way to break all the black lights <NL>and rescue her once again from the dangerous situation…” <NL><NL>At that moment, everyone had tears, and heaven and earth fell silent…
1512a4b5-e80a-487b-bd18-a74142dc3688/Eve.cn: 话音未落，徐仙公与念支离化身已自殿外并肩走入，<NL>徐仙公目光落在<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />身上，纵使面为木造，亦不免透出哀伤：<NL><NL>“也正因焕心女娃舍身相护……<NL>此番方能带着太吾小娃顺利脱身，逃出生天……<NL>那丫头心底里信着，若是太吾小娃，定有法子破尽黑光，<NL>将她从险局之中，再次救回……”<NL><NL>一时，众皆有泪，天地无声……

7d1f5932-6131-4555-ab7a-53320cd809ab/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, upon hearing this, could no longer think of anything else and quickly took out the “Fuyu Hilt” for a closer look. <NL><NL>On the hilt, twelve Dark Auras could be faintly seen slithering and winding like snakes or vipers, coiling without dispersing. <NL>Huanxin, with her own strength, was distracting the Mt. Chai Ancestor and those twelve black lights, <NL>but the Mt. Chai Ancestor and the twelve black lights also firmly trapped Huanxin, <NL>stuck in a stalemate, mutually binding her, unable to free herself even a little, <NL>a truly deadly impasse…
7d1f5932-6131-4555-ab7a-53320cd809ab/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />听罢，再顾不得其他，忙将「伏虞剑柄」取出细看。<NL><NL>但见那剑柄之上，隐隐有十二道黑气蜿蜒游走，如蛇如蜮，缠绕不散，<NL>焕心以一己之力，牵制住柴山元祖与那十二道黑光，<NL>可那柴山元祖与那十二道黑光，亦将焕心牢牢困住，<NL>彼此僵持，相互束缚，令她半分也脱身不得，<NL>正是生死胶着之局……

If there are any in this world willing to abandon their physical bodies and exist as thoughts, <NL>you may have them take the 'Mind-Severing Pills' and recruit them as Dispassionate Ones."
0a9f639a-ee2f-4005-a2ed-a7bc361d64bd/Eve.cn: 念支离化身待众人议定，<NL>这才缓步行至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />身前，垂眸说道：<NL><NL>“此番无念众折损过甚，世间若有自愿舍弃肉身、以念存世之人，<NL>你可令其服用‘绝念泥丸’，收为无念之众。”

266429c5-b4fd-4f38-b12d-853d9352231b/Eve.en: "The Mind-Severing Pills are made using the secret method of the Dispassionate. <NL>Those who take them can abandon their physical bodies and exist solely as thoughts... <NL>If you make good use of them, they will surely become a great aid in your achievement as the True Demon..." <NL><NL>Before the Nian Zhili Incarnation had finished speaking, <NL>his form suddenly disintegrated inch by inch, and in the blink of an eye, he scattered into a cloud of ashes. <NL>From within those ashes, six pills condensed into shape, colored reddish-brown, with a faint, hidden glow. <NL>Soon, the pills slowly floated up and drifted into the palm of <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />...
266429c5-b4fd-4f38-b12d-853d9352231b/Eve.cn: “绝念泥丸以无念秘法所制，<NL>服者可舍弃肉身，仅以念存世……<NL>你若善用此物，自当为你成就真魔之一大助力……”<NL><NL>念支离话音未落，<NL>身形忽而寸寸崩解，眨眼之间，竟而散作一蓬灰烬，<NL>而那灰烬之中，正有六枚泥丸凝结成形，色呈赤褐，隐有幽光，<NL>俄而，泥丸缓缓飘起，悠悠飞入<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />掌中……

266429c5-b4fd-4f38-b12d-853d9352231b/Opt.en: These are the 'Mind-Severing Pills'... (Put the 'Mind-Severing Pills' into the pouch...)
266429c5-b4fd-4f38-b12d-853d9352231b/Opt.cn: 这便是“绝念泥丸”……（将“绝念泥丸”收入囊中……）
266429c5-b4fd-4f38-b12d-853d9352231b/Opt.ru: Это "Таблетки, отключающие разум"... (Положите "Таблетки, отключающие разум" в мешочек...)

e0742321-e074-441b-abda-5fe0d57875ae/Eve.en: The situation was urgent, so no one delayed any longer. <NL>After bidding each other farewell, they prepared to set off. <NL>They saw <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> gently stroking the "Fuyu Hilt", sensing the locations of the twelve evil beings, and pointing out the directions one by one for everyone. <NL>Everyone said "Take care" in unison, then went their separate ways, rushing swiftly toward the places indicated by <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />. <NL><NL>Outside the Taiwu Ancestral Temple, the wind howled, figures gradually faded into the distance, <NL>leaving only faint residual light, illuminating the road ahead...
e0742321-e074-441b-abda-5fe0d57875ae/Eve.cn: 事态紧迫，众人不再耽搁，<NL>各自辞别，便要动身而去。<NL>只见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />轻抚「伏虞剑柄」，感应着那十二邪物所在，一一为众人指明方位，<NL>而众人齐道一声“珍重”，随即各奔东西，朝着<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />所指之处疾行而去。<NL><NL>太吾祠堂之外，风声四起，人影渐远，<NL>唯余残光淡淡，映照前路……

e0742321-e074-441b-abda-5fe0d57875ae/Opt.en: (Set out to subdue the twelve evil beings and rescue Huanxin...)
e0742321-e074-441b-abda-5fe0d57875ae/Opt.cn: （前往降伏十二邪物，救出焕心……）
e0742321-e074-441b-abda-5fe0d57875ae/Opt.ru: (Отправился покорять двенадцать злых существ и спасать Хуаньсинь...)

0f44aca8-a199-482f-9e31-3f5563b3a663/Eve.en: The heavens and earth are vast, demons plague the world, <NL>all burdens fall upon <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />'s shoulders, <NL>yet the path ahead is clear, this journey will be fearless, <NL>to subdue the twelve evil beings and bring Huanxin back, <NL>to achieve the form of the True Demon, to eradicate the Xiangshu demon, <NL><NL>and restore this mortal world to a bright and clear Pure Brightness!
0f44aca8-a199-482f-9e31-3f5563b3a663/Eve.cn: 天地苍茫，妖魔祸世，<NL>万般干系皆担于<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />肩上，<NL>然而前路已明，此行一往无前，<NL>降伏十二邪仙，救得焕心归来，<NL>成就真魔之身，除灭相枢妖魔，<NL><NL>还此间尘世一片朗朗乾坤，清明天地！

0f44aca8-a199-482f-9e31-3f5563b3a663/Opt.en: (No time to lose, set off immediately!)

00ea2ba8-abc2-400c-a8fa-1e03d4d4b972/Eve.en: "I do know something of the events of the past!" <NL><NL>Long Yufu folded her arms, her gaze blazing, and said loudly: <NL>"In ancient times, when heaven and earth were first divided and all things began to flourish, twelve Celestial Immortals attained the Tao at Kunlun, <NL>together governing the karma of the mortal world and maintaining the order of heaven and earth."
00ea2ba8-abc2-400c-a8fa-1e03d4d4b972/Eve.cn: “此中往事，我倒知晓几分！”<NL><NL>龙语茯双臂抱胸，目光灼灼，朗声说道：<NL>“上古之时，天地开辟，万物生衍，有十二位上仙得道于昆仑，<NL>共掌人世因果，维系天地秩序。”

6ab1dbcf-76b7-482d-b0ba-a9e4ffa1434e/Eve.en: "However, ever since the Xiangshu broke free from the Demon-Caging Divine Furnace, <NL>in order to corrode this world and destabilize the order of heaven and earth, <NL>it drove demons to harass those twelve Celestial Immortals, causing them to gradually wane... <NL><NL>Until they helped the silly little Taoist forge the first 'Fuyu Sword', <NL>after which, for some unknown reason, they all vanished without a trace."
6ab1dbcf-76b7-482d-b0ba-a9e4ffa1434e/Eve.cn: “然而，自相枢挣脱梏妖神炉以来，<NL>为侵蚀此方世界、动摇天地秩序，<NL>便驱使妖魔侵扰那十二位上仙，以至众仙日益衰微……<NL><NL>直到，他们助傻小道铸成最初的「伏虞剑」后，<NL>竟不知何故，尽皆销声匿迹。”

6ab1dbcf-76b7-482d-b0ba-a9e4ffa1434e/Opt.en: The twelve Celestial Immortals all vanished without a trace...
6ab1dbcf-76b7-482d-b0ba-a9e4ffa1434e/Opt.cn: 十二上仙尽皆销声匿迹……
6ab1dbcf-76b7-482d-b0ba-a9e4ffa1434e/Opt.ru: Все двенадцать Небесных Бессмертных исчезли без следа...

346694d4-2151-4368-b4b8-cbe9803b45d4/Eve.en: After listening to Long Yufu's words, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> carefully recalled his past experiences and couldn't help but guess: <NL><NL>The twelve Celestial Immortals had once worked together to forge the 'Fuyu Sword', <NL>and after the sword was completed, they suddenly disappeared. <NL>Was it related to those twelve black lights... <NL><NL>Could it be... that the evil power of the Xiangshu was so strong that <NL>even the twelve Celestial Immortals could not resist, becoming Possessed and turning into twelve dark lights...
346694d4-2151-4368-b4b8-cbe9803b45d4/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />听罢龙语茯所言，细细回想此前经历，心中不免横生猜测：<NL><NL>十二上仙曾齐心协力铸就「伏虞剑」，<NL>剑成之后，却突然消失，<NL>是否与那十二道黑光有所关联……<NL><NL>莫非……相枢的邪力当真强横至此，<NL>纵使十二上仙也无法抵抗，入魔化作了十二道邪光……

346694d4-2151-4368-b4b8-cbe9803b45d4/Opt.en: Could it be that the twelve Celestial Immortals fell into the demonic path and turned into twelve evil lights?
346694d4-2151-4368-b4b8-cbe9803b45d4/Opt.cn: 莫非，是那十二位上仙堕入魔道，化作了十二道邪光？
346694d4-2151-4368-b4b8-cbe9803b45d4/Opt.ru: Могло ли быть так, что двенадцать Небесных Бессмертных встали на демонический путь и превратились в двенадцать злых огней?

4371f147-58c8-4ecf-8de5-6c51c5aa5780/Eve.en: The Nian Zhili Incarnation slowly shook his head, his expression calm: <NL><NL>"Where the twelve Celestial Immortals went, I have searched the world and still know nothing. <NL>However, I unexpectedly discovered that twelve evil beings, which had been lurking for a long time, <NL>revived after you rescued Huanxin and broke through the Abyss..."
4371f147-58c8-4ecf-8de5-6c51c5aa5780/Eve.cn: 念支离化身缓缓摇头，神色淡然：<NL><NL>“十二上仙去了何处，我遍访世间，仍是一无所知，<NL>不过倒是意外察觉，有十二个蛰伏已久的邪物，<NL>在你救出焕心、破开玄狱之后，复生而出……”

09475ebd-99e5-4c09-b4c1-5b464bde3e74/Eve.en: "The revival of the evil beings is no coincidence. <NL>I suspect they are driven by the Xiangshu, together with the Ancestor of Mt. Chai, <NL>to seize the Realm-Steadfast Divine Stone, kill Nian and return to Taiwu, and capture Huanxin's spirit. It is fortunate that... <NL>now, Huanxin has distracted all of them within Mt. Chai..."
09475ebd-99e5-4c09-b4c1-5b464bde3e74/Eve.cn: “邪物复生，绝非偶然，<NL>想来是受相枢驱使，与柴山元祖一道，<NL>夺镇界神石，诛念回太吾，捉焕心元神，好在……<NL>而今，焕心将他们尽数牵制在了柴山……”

09475ebd-99e5-4c09-b4c1-5b464bde3e74/Opt.en: Huanxin... (a pang of pain in my heart...)

d042aa23-0858-4a09-b7df-4e74a1a81561/Eve.en: Immortal Xu sighed upon hearing this and then chimed in: <NL><NL>"In my opinion, these twelve evil beings <NL>are the very dharma treasures that the twelve Celestial Immortals relied on in the past. <NL>After being long contaminated by the Xiangshu's Demonic Qi, they fell into evil, <NL>took on human form, lurked in the mundane world, absorbing worldly suffering to sustain the invincible body of the Ancestor of Mt. Chai..."
d042aa23-0858-4a09-b7df-4e74a1a81561/Eve.cn: 徐仙公闻言一叹，接口说道：<NL><NL>“依老夫所见，这十二邪物，<NL>便是十二上仙昔日的立身法宝，<NL>因久受相枢魔气侵染，这才堕为妖邪，<NL>化作人形，潜伏尘世，汲取世间苦难，维系柴山元祖不败之身……”

d042aa23-0858-4a09-b7df-4e74a1a81561/Opt.en: (If we eliminate these twelve evil beings...)
d042aa23-0858-4a09-b7df-4e74a1a81561/Opt.ru: (Если мы уничтожим эти двенадцать злых существ...)

2c10b476-472f-4d69-a9d7-82156acc7893/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> pondered for a moment, <NL>carefully weighing the words of the two in his mind, gradually sorting things out: <NL>If he could exterminate those twelve evil beings, not only could he completely eliminate the Ancestor of Mt. Chai, but he could also dissolve the twelve black lights entangled with Huanxin. <NL>Once the black lights disperse, Huanxin can naturally break free and see the light of day again...
2c10b476-472f-4d69-a9d7-82156acc7893/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />细思片刻，<NL>将二人所言在心中反复推敲，渐渐理出头绪：<NL>若能诛灭那十二邪物，不仅可将柴山元祖彻底除去，更能消解那与焕心纠缠的十二道黑光。<NL>一旦黑光散尽，焕心自可脱困，重见天日……

2c10b476-472f-4d69-a9d7-82156acc7893/Opt.en: If we eliminate these twelve evil beings, can we then rescue Huanxin? (Voicing his thoughts...)
2c10b476-472f-4d69-a9d7-82156acc7893/Opt.cn: 若是除去这十二邪物，是否便能救出焕心？（道出所思……）
2c10b476-472f-4d69-a9d7-82156acc7893/Opt.ru: Если мы уничтожим эти двенадцать злых существ, сможем ли мы тогда спасти Хуаньсинь? (Озвучивает свои мысли...)

70842df7-175f-4726-ae43-3395d9af9192/Eve.en: "That is correct. The twelve evil beings must be utterly eradicated... <NL>To achieve the True Demon, both you and Huanxin are indispensable." <NL><NL>The Nian Zhili Incarnation spoke solemnly, still expressionless...
70842df7-175f-4726-ae43-3395d9af9192/Eve.cn: “正是如此，十二邪物，必绝其根……<NL>成就真魔，你与焕心，缺一不可。”<NL><NL>念支离化身沉声说道，仍是面无表情……
70842df7-175f-4726-ae43-3395d9af9192/Eve.ru: - Это верно. Двенадцать злых существ должны быть полностью уничтожены... <NL>Чтобы достичь Истинного Демона, и ты, и Хуаньсинь незаменимы." <NL><NL>Воплощение Нянь Чжили говорило торжественно, по-прежнему без всякого выражения...

4b25b5ea-9d7d-4bfb-88ee-1fa29cd94a6d/Eve.en: With this said, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name /> understood clearly in his heart, <NL>Nian Zhili had never been willing to state outright the method to achieve True Demon, <NL>but from the implication of his words, the method to achieve True Demon is mostly bound to Nian Hui, and Huanxin is precisely the key to Nian Hui, <NL><NL>Alone, even if he could rescue Huanxin, <NL>delays would invite change, so he absolutely must not allow any delay, <NL>Since their goals are no different, they should unite their efforts to exterminate the twelve evil beings and rescue Huanxin from her predicament...
4b25b5ea-9d7d-4bfb-88ee-1fa29cd94a6d/Eve.cn: 言至于此，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />心中已然明了，<NL>念支离虽始终未肯明言成就真魔之法，<NL>但如今听其言中之意，成就真魔之法多半系于念回，而焕心便正是念回之关键，<NL><NL>自己孤身一人，纵能救得焕心，<NL>然迟则生变，万不可稍有迁延，<NL>既然彼此所图无二，自当戮力同心，剿灭十二邪物，救得焕心脱困……

4b25b5ea-9d7d-4bfb-88ee-1fa29cd94a6d/Opt.ru: (Я ничего не желаю больше, чем этого!)

db4d83ab-2e50-4366-ae87-be58f16d2c5d/Eve.en: "It's a long story, but let me make it short!"<NL><NL>Long Yufu put down the porcelain bowl and turned to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />, saying:<NL>"From the moment you escaped the Land of Blackstones and rescued Huanxin,<NL>I knew the time to achieve True Demon had come, so I secretly sent messages and summoned the Dispassionate Ones here!"
db4d83ab-2e50-4366-ae87-be58f16d2c5d/Eve.cn: “此事说来话长，我且长话短说！”<NL><NL>龙语茯搁下瓷碗，转向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name />说道：<NL>“自你从玄石之境脱身、救出焕心的那一刻起，<NL>我便知晓成就真魔的时机已至，是以暗中传讯，召集无念众前来！”

db4d83ab-2e50-4366-ae87-be58f16d2c5d/Opt.en: (So that day after parting from the Illusion, the Dispassionate Ones had already begun to act...)
db4d83ab-2e50-4366-ae87-be58f16d2c5d/Opt.cn: （原来当日幻境一别，无念众便已开始行动……）
db4d83ab-2e50-4366-ae87-be58f16d2c5d/Opt.ru: (Итак, в тот день, расставшись с Иллюзией, Бесстрастные уже начали действовать...)

8d6e3ba7-d2de-4944-af88-a8f56ec04dab/Eve.en: "Later, hearing that you had gone to Mt. Chai,<NL>Nian Zhili grew restless, sensing a great calamity was imminent, so he manifested his Incarnation and led the Dispassionate Ones to investigate.<NL>And indeed, he met Immortal Xu by the sea, that old wooden man running around in panic, saying you were trapped by a powerful foe..."
8d6e3ba7-d2de-4944-af88-a8f56ec04dab/Eve.cn: “后来听闻你前往柴山，<NL>念支离便心神不宁，预感大祸将临，于是化身而出，率无念众前去探查，<NL>竟果然在海边遇见了徐仙公，那老木头急得团团转，说你已被强敌困住……”

8d6e3ba7-d2de-4944-af88-a8f56ec04dab/Opt.en: So Immortal Xu did find help after all...
8d6e3ba7-d2de-4944-af88-a8f56ec04dab/Opt.ru: Значит, Бессмертный Сюй все-таки нашел помощь...

8c849983-b4cc-4e22-a22f-281222ebffe7/Eve.en: "That old wooden man, once he saw us arrive, hesitated no longer.<NL>He immediately cleaved open the black mist with his Mystic Bamboo and went to aid at the Divine Furnace Ruins.<NL><NL>However... even without us, with your ability as Taiwu, you could have escaped..."
8c849983-b4cc-4e22-a22f-281222ebffe7/Eve.cn: “那老木头一见我们来了，便也不再踌躇，<NL>当即以玄竹辟开黑雾，前往神炉遗迹相助，<NL><NL>不过……纵无我等，以你太吾之能，亦能脱困……”
8c849983-b4cc-4e22-a22f-281222ebffe7/Eve.ru: - Этот старый деревянный человечек, как только увидел, что мы прибыли, больше не колебался.<NL>Он немедленно рассек черный туман своим Мистическим бамбуком и отправился на помощь к руинам Божественной печи.<NL><NL>Однако... даже без нас, с твоими способностями Тайу, ты мог бы сбежать..."

0f0f8e48-dc8f-48a7-9235-2ba6df54a2f1/Eve.en: As Long Yufu finished speaking, Nian Zhili slowly said:<NL><NL>"Though I cannot accompany you myself,<NL>these Dispassionate Ones will protect you in my stead, helping you subdue the evil..."
0f0f8e48-dc8f-48a7-9235-2ba6df54a2f1/Eve.cn: 龙语茯话音甫落，念支离便即缓缓说道：<NL><NL>“我却不能亲自伴你身侧，<NL>然这无念之众，自会代我护你周全，助你伏邪……”
0f0f8e48-dc8f-48a7-9235-2ba6df54a2f1/Eve.ru: Когда Лонг Юфу закончил говорить, Нянь Чжили медленно произнесла:<NL><NL>- Хотя сам я не могу сопровождать вас,<NL>эти Бесстрастные защитят тебя вместо меня, помогая тебе победить зло..."
